reason: This looks like more than a local cleanup: it touches shared optimizer-rule infrastructure in `pkg/planner/core`, specifically TopN pushdown, predicate pushdown, and physical plan generation paths. Even if framed as encapsulation/refactoring, moving default pushdown behavior into `baseLogicalPlan` can silently change planner semantics across many logical operators, with potential wrong-plan or wrong-result fallout. That blast radius is central enough to justify a focused deep review.
